purpose: Convert frozen model outputs into teacher-facing decision-support signals.

academic_risk.policy_note: The 40-mark benchmark is grounded in the supplied school source sheets. Other presentation bands are V1 operational defaults and must remain configurable.

prediction_reliability.basis: Final held-out subject performance and final-test sample support.

LOW.definition: Sufficient held-out sample but performance below moderate thresholds.

INSUFFICIENT_DATA.definition: fewer than 20 held-out subject observations, or unusable evaluation metrics

prediction_reliability.important_note: Prediction reliability is not an individual probability and must not be called confidence.

shap_explanation.purpose: Explain why a frozen model prediction was pushed higher or lower.

ui_separation.academic_risk: How concerning the predicted academic outcome is.
ui_separation.prediction_reliability: How strong the held-out evidence is for predictions of this type.
ui_separation.attendance_context: Historical attendance information shown to the teacher but not used by the final forecasting model.
